facts.fact: Moukénet and colleagues (BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making) state that in Chad HMIS data are collected by health facilities on paper forms, checked by the facility manager and reported to the health district, where the zonal chief or district manager converts the data of health facilities and district hospitals to electronic format in Microsoft Excel and sends them by email or flash key to the provincial delegation and then the ministry; the description is undated and is placed at the article's publication year.

Moukénet and colleagues describe reporting at health-centre level as paper-based throughout, with stock-outs of register books at 37.5% and of HMIS forms at 12.5% of the 16 health centres of Massaguet district during 2018, and recommend moving from paper forms to a web-based HMIS; no health centre is described as entering its own data.

Moukénet and colleagues state that health centres and district hospitals report monthly into the HMIS on paper, and measured reporting completeness of 95.24% (CI 90.83-97.92) in the HMIS data of 14 government-recognised health centres in Massaguet district for January-December 2018, with attendance and malaria cases over-reported against the registers (verification factors 1.41 to 2.86).

Moukénet and colleagues state that HMIS data end at the health ministry's Department of Statistics and Health Information (SDSIS), which verifies their consistency at central level and supervises districts and health centres with the malaria programme and the provincial delegation; the description is undated and is placed at the article's publication year.

systems.platform: paper forms at the facility; Microsoft Excel at the district
systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Department of Statistics and Health Information (SDSIS)
systems.tiers: health centres and district hospitals report on paper to the health district, which keys the data; then provincial health delegation and ministry

systems.country_label: Monthly Malaria Report (RMP) forms; malaria data collection forms
systems.owner: National Malaria Control Program (NMCP), with Global Fund support under PALAT
systems.tiers: health centres, sent on to the NMCP alongside the HMIS; validated quarterly at central level
